title: Tree-Tomography: quantitative tomography of internal decay in living trees, including the ERT image analysis application
description: Code and data for the Harvard Forest tomography study of internal decay in four tree species (Thompson et al. 2026), including the open-source R/Shiny application that extracts quantitative metrics (mean, median, SD, CV, Gini, entropy, central moisture accumulation, radial gradient and an 8-ring radial profile) from PiCUS electrical resistance tomograms.
